failure_diagnosis: The Chinese state prompt_action text was close to target wording and was copied as a generic state template. This produced per-state template collapse and negative V30 permutation NLL.

fix.prompt_contract: Replace direct Chinese state_action prose with a non-copyable structural PROCESS_CODE.
fix.v30_contract: Keep all 30 compact value phrases and eight semantic-role-transition-selected long cues.
fix.evaluation_contract: Draw each held-out V30 counterfactual from the whole held-out participant pool, rather than a file-order-dependent generation prefix.
fix.selector_contract: Require separately observed segment-role and KC-transition responsiveness.

state_alignment.evidence: 134/134 V7 r1 participant sequences exactly match route_a_training_v2_latest_states_candidate/draft; the other 28 participants were excluded by strict V7 text/personality validation.
state_alignment.reason: Eight choice options and three Q2 cards still need manual-dominant-action decisions under the latest C-K manual before a formal mapping/data rebuild can be frozen.
state_alignment.training_policy: No further formal Planner or Realizer training from this raw-aligned V7 subset.

local_verification.command: PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m unittest discover -s route_a/tests -p test_*.py

post_r5_engineering_fixes.decoder: Single-step free generation now caps at 45 new tokens, consistent with the 15-45 character V7 step target contract.

post_r5_engineering_fixes.training_policy: Not retrained because the formal state-alignment adjudication is still blocked.

submission_fallback.claim_boundary: Qualitative frozen-model baseline only; it is not an empirically validated personalized Realizer.

result.diagnosis: Removing copyable state prose eliminated the literal state-definition template but did not establish state or V30 conditionality. Both variants over-generate generic scenario-balancing text and exceed the 15-45 character step-output contract.

next_gate: First complete the state-mapping adjudication and rebuild formal Q2/V7. Then redesign the step target/decoding length contract and add a condition-sensitive free-generation objective before rerunning smoke.
